description: A test script for 'git pack-redundant' command, creating various pack and object scenarios, checking for redundancy, and cleaning up packs in git repositories.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates commits in a given repository, assigning each commit's oid to provided variable names.

methods.name: create_pack_in
methods.description: Creates a pack in a repository with commits read from stdin, assigns pack id to a variable.

methods.name: format_packfiles
methods.description: Formats pack filenames by extracting pack ids and sorting them.
